outcome: Peripheral thyrotoxicosis (FT3 levels, tachycardia, blood pressure, transaminases)

Neurodevelopmental outcomes (cognitive and motor disability, global developmental delay, head control, recognition of caregiver, response to his name, Bayley Scales of Infant Developmental 3rd Edition scores)
cohort: A single five-month-old boy diagnosed with Monocarboxylate transporter 8 (MCT8) deficiency, presenting with feeding difficulty, central hypotonia, and global developmental delay.
finding: Treatment with Triac successfully resolved peripheral thyrotoxicosis and appeared to slow neurodevelopmental regression, with some developmental milestones achieved after one year.
